graphEvents.label: Approval answer survival across restart and replay
Grant scope is not part of the answer idempotency key
008 dispatch-env mitigation is unimplementable against an exact-match allowlist

label: The grant scope is not part of the answer identity: answerItem compares only answer.text, so a same-text answer with a different scope returns duplicate and the standing allow is lost
006's always scope does not outlive its item, but 003 labels a key and an overlay choice always, so the operator reads a promise the phase does not build
The Telegram bot token travels in the request URL path and no 011 requirement redacts it before an error, a log or a queue entry
011 REQ-014 reads the token at send time, but Telegram long polling and Slack Socket Mode need it to open the connection before any send
Approval authority is split three ways: 011 gates on an operators.json roster, 003 gates on nothing, and 006's ladder takes no actor, with no phase stating the model
Inbound chat text becomes the run prompt with no untrusted framing: 010 appends the transcript after the BOT.md body and 011 routes any non-answer line into that path
011's approval index has no expiry and no removal rule, so it grows without bound and a stale entry can resolve a press for an item answered hours ago
An unknown send is never retried and never surfaced: bots channel list reports only queue depth, so a lost approval prompt is invisible

008's mitigation for the dispatch-env gate cannot be implemented as written: assertDispatchEnvAllowed admits exact keys only and buildExecutorDispatchEnv filters the parent env, so a SKILLED_BOT_SECRET_ prefix is admitted by neither
